nextSteps: A physical Apple Silicon Mac: per-process Firefox energy, no setup or admin rights. The most precise option.
A Linux PC on bare metal with an Intel or AMD CPU: run `sudo sysctl kernel.perf_event_paranoid=0` once per boot. Measures the whole CPU package, so close other applications.
A Windows 11 PC on a supported Intel, AMD or ARM CPU: CPU package energy, no setup.
Run the CLI on one of these, or register it as a self-hosted runner so issue scans use it (docs/self-hosted-runner.md).

findings.action: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) so layout is computed once rather than recalculated per image.

findings.title: Large stylesheet surface (12,552 selectors)
findings.evidence: 6,526 rules across 4 stylesheets, 12,552 selectors total.
findings.action: The style system may match many of these against every element. Split CSS per route so pages load only what they use, and drop rules for components not present.

findings.title: 5 image(s) far larger than displayed
findings.evidence: Worst: facebook-icon_square_32x32.png is 1024x more pixels than its displayed size.
findings.action: Decoding happens at natural size regardless of CSS scaling, so this is wasted CPU and memory as well as bytes. Serve responsive variants sized to the layout.

findings.title: 23 script elements
findings.evidence: 23 scripts (2 inline).
findings.action: Each script is parsed, compiled and executed. In Drupal, check whether libraries are attached globally that only some pages need.

findings.title: 10 selectors with high match cost
findings.evidence: .addtoany_list a > span (deep descendant chain); .addtoany_list.a2a_kit_size_32 a > span (deep descendant chain); .social-media-links--platforms.vertical li a img (deep descendant chain)
findings.action: Universal selectors, long descendant chains and :has()/:not() are matched right-to-left against many elements. Prefer a single class on the target element.
